text: what is enormous? because my map is not enormous. my map is effectively the size of 3 dust2 put side by side
resolution: Corrected my mis-diagnosis: the dev-host crash is a V8 heap OOM, and the cause is NOT the map (it's ~3x dust2, moderate, as the user said) — it's the bake enumerating ~850k procedural FLORA rows (234k flowers + 614k palm fronds) into a ~132MB V8 array every compile. Fixed by recipe-izing flowers + palm fronds (see req_1861, SHAs 0c621111f + 018b57b24): they now ship as compact per-cell recipe cells the loader regenerates, dropping the bake instance buffer ~892k→~44k rows. The V8/loader distinction was the key insight (OOM = bake/V8; per-blade expansion = loader/GPU, separate).
